The WebSurfer agent failed to execute a search query capable of retrieving the actual content of search results pages (consistently returning only browser upgrade messages), yet the Planner proceeded to treat this non-existent data as verified fact. suggested_fix.fix_text: Before concluding a fact from search results, the Planner must explicitly quote the specific sentence confirming the relationship. If the search results do not contain explicit confirmation of the relationship (husband/father), the Planner must issue a search query specifically looking for 'Adam Coleman Howard mother marriage' or 'Adam Coleman Howard paternal vs maternal grandfather' rather than relying on inferred genealogical connections from a third party.
